series.notes: Legacy fixed-speed TAC-07CS service manual Failure Display p22. Separate from inverter split — same digits may differ.

title.ur: Kamre ke temperature sensor ki kharabi (legacy fixed-speed)

meaning.en: Room sensor fault shown on digital display; RUN lamp flashes once per cycle.
meaning.ur: Kamre ke sensor ka fault digital display par nazar aata hai; RUN lamp har cycle mein ek baar chalta hai.

causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch off the AC at the mains and wait 5 minutes before opening the indoor panel.
solutions.ur: AC ka mains band kar ke panel kholne se pehle 5 minute intezar karein.

solutions.en: With power off, unplug the room-sensor connector on the indoor board, clean the pins and re-seat it firmly; after power returns the sensor should read room temperature normally.
solutions.ur: Power band karne ke baad indoor board se room-sensor connector nikal kar pins saaf karein aur mazbooti se dobara lagayein; power aane ke baad sensor kamre ka temperature theek parh le.

solutions.en: If the fault remains, measure the thermistor resistance with a multimeter at room temperature and compare it with the manual chart; replace the thermistor if it reads open or short.
solutions.ur: Masla rahe to multimeter se kamre ka temperature par thermistor ka resistance naapein aur manual ke chart se milayein; open ya short parhe to thermistor badlein.

source.title: TCL TAC-07CS Service Manual (fixed-speed TAC-07…24 CS/CK/CHS family) — Failure Display p22

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp once/cycle; digital display E1

title.ur: Indoor pipe temperature sensor kharab hona (legacy)

meaning.en: Indoor pipe sensor fault; RUN lamp flashes twice per cycle.
meaning.ur: Indoor pipe sensor ka fault; RUN lamp har cycle mein do baar chalta hai.

causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye
Thermistor ka plug dheela ho jaye

solutions.en: Turn the AC off at the breaker before opening the indoor unit.
solutions.ur: Indoor unit kholne se pehle breaker se AC band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the pipe-sensor plug on the indoor board and check the wire for chafing; the plug should sit tight and readings should return to normal.
solutions.ur: Indoor board par pipe-sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur wire ka ghisna check karein; plug poori tarah baith jaye aur readings normal ho jani chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor against the manual resistance-temperature chart and replace it if it is open or short.
solutions.ur: Manual ke resistance-temperature chart se thermistor naap kar dekhein; open ya short ho to thermistor badlein.

source.title: TCL TAC-07CS Service Manual (fixed-speed TAC-07…24 CS/CK/CHS family) — Failure Display p22

notes.ur: Har code ka source service_manual hai.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp twice/cycle; digital display E2

meaning.en: Generic outdoor protection on fixed-speed units (≠ model-mismatch E5 of inverter series); lamp flashes 5 times/cycle.
meaning.ur: Fixed-speed units par aam outdoor protection; lamp har cycle mein 5 baar chalta hai (inverter series ke model-mismatch E5 se alag).

causes.ur: Outdoor protection trip ho jaye — pressure/thermal
Outdoor unit tak ki wiring dheeli ho jaye

solutions.en: Do not restart the unit straight away; turn off the mains and let the outdoor unit cool down.
solutions.ur: Unit foran start na karein; mains se power band kar ke outdoor ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the wiring between indoor and outdoor — tighten loose terminals and repair any cut wire; connections must be tight and numbering correct.
solutions.ur: Power band hon par indoor aur outdoor ki wiring check karein — dheele terminals katein aur kati hui wire theek karein; connections mazboot hone chahiye aur number theek hone chahiye.

solutions.en: If the wiring is fine, follow the manual's protection troubleshooting (pressure and thermal checks) and reset the unit.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to manual ka protection wala troubleshooting follow karein (pressure aur thermal check) aur unit reset kar dein.

source.title: TCL TAC-07CS Service Manual (fixed-speed TAC-07…24 CS/CK/CHS family) — Failure Display p22

notes.en: Meaning differs from inverter-series E5 (model mismatch). Per-code attribution: service_manual.
notes.ur: Yeh meaning inverter-series E5 se alag hai (model ka farq). Har code ka source service_manual hai.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp 5 times/cycle; digital display E5

meaning.en: Indoor fan fault; lamp flashes 6 times/cycle.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan ka fault; lamp har cycle mein 6 baar chalta hai.

causes.ur: Fan motor ya capacitor kharab ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch off power at the breaker and remove the indoor front cover.
solutions.ur: Breaker se power band kar ke indoor ka front cover utarein.

solutions.en: Turn the fan blade by hand — it must spin freely; if it is stuck, clear debris and check the bushing.
solutions.ur: Fan blade ko haath se ghoomayein — use azaadi se ghoomna chahiye; atka ho to gandah nikaal kar bushing check karein.

solutions.en: Test the motor and run capacitor with a meter, and replace the capacitor or motor if either one has failed.
solutions.ur: Meter se motor aur run capacitor check karein; kisi ka bhi masla ho to capacitor ya motor badlein.
